## Skin information

* Champion: Yasuo
* Modified skin: Spirit Blossom Yasuo
* Author: Konari Lab Ch. 白夜こなり
* In order to use this skin, you need to own **Spirit Blossom Yasuo** and select it in champion select.

## Specifications

* New model and texture
* Supports all champion texture quality settings
* Modified loadingscreen
* Modified in-game/skill icons
* Modified particles
* New voiceover

## Credits

* Thanks Marcius for helping me with Prestige VFX.

## Known issues

* The model’s weighting isn’t perfect so it might have some issues regarding some animations.
